# Commands dashboard reliability: Phabricator loading and automatic build status

Older backends can expose generic failed status plus a specific dependency-update phase. Normalize only when that automatic phase explicitly says cancelled/interrupted. The visible validated tooltip was `Automatic Rust update cancelled. Automatic build was cancelled.` [Task 2]

Scope: console.
